summary: Tests whether string a2 contains the literal at global aNoplayer via sub_566810 and, when the substring is found, sets the flag at this[4715] (offset 0x49AC) to 1. Returns the substring-search result.

operations.description: Call sub_566810(a2, aNoplayer) to search a2 for the global literal string.
Guard on the search result being non-zero (substring found).
Set this[4715] (offset 0x49AC) to 1 when the guard passes.

unresolved: Contents of the global literal aNoplayer and the exact semantics of sub_566810 are not defined here.
Meaning of the flag at offset 0x49AC depends on the enclosing object; the existing analysis suggests no-player mode.
